answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. The result is a self-purifying economy: every epoch, low-cost fake identities are filtered out by the same reputation mechanics that reward the honest ones.
